summary: 2. By way of this Petition, the Petitioner is seeking revision of fees and charges from the ‘Date of Commercial Operation’ (COD) to 31.3.2014 and for the 2014-19 tariff period for two Assets, namely, Asset-2 and Asset-3, under Fiber Optic Communication System in lieu of existing Unified Load Dispatch and Communication (ULDC) Microwave Links in Northern Region, pursuant to the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (APTEL) judgment dated 28.10.2022 in Appeal No. 15 of 2016, emanating out of the Commission’s order dated 1.9.2015 in Petition No.240/TT/2013, whereby the Commission’s said order dated 1.9.2015 in Petition No. 240/TT/2013 was remanded back for reconsideration. _b) Approve the trued-up Fees & charges & tariff for 2019-24 block and fees & charges & tariff for 2024-29 block for the asset covered under this petition, as per para 13 & 14 above. c) Allow the petitioner to recover income tax directly from the beneficiaries for Asset-1 to 4._ _d) Allow the petitioner to recover the shortfall or refund the excess Annual Fixed Charges, on account of Return on Equity due to change in applicable Minimum Alternate/Corporate Income Tax rate as per the Income Tax Act, 1961 (as amended from time to time) of the respective financial year directly without making any application before the Commission as provided in Tariff Regulations, 2019 and Tariff Regulations, 2024 as per para 13 & 14 above for respective block._ _g) Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before Hon’ble Commission for claiming the overall security expenses and consequential IOWC on that security expenses as mentioned at para 19 above._ _h) Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before Hon’ble Commission for claiming the overall insurance expenses and consequential IOWC on that insurance expenses as mentioned at para 19 above._ _i) Allow the petitioner to file a separate petition before Hon’ble Commission for claiming the overall capital spares at the end of tariff block as per actual as mentioned at Para 19 above._ _j) Allow the petitioner to claim expenses of CTUIL borne by POWERGRID through a separate petition as mentioned at para 20 above._ _and pass such other relief as Hon’ble Commission deems fit and appropriate under the circumstances of the case and in the interest of justice_ - (d) The Petitioner filed a Miscellaneous Petition No. 68/2010 under subsection (4) of Section 28 of the Electricity Act 2003 and Regulations 44 "Power to Relax" of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations 2009 for the fixation of tariff norms for the recovery of costs for the assets ("Communication System" and "Sub-Load Dispatch Centre System") to be retained or installed by the Petitioner after the formation of POSOCO for the 2009-14 period. - (e) The Commission in Petition No. 68/2010, vide order dated 8.12.2011, observed as follows: different regions, retained by the Petitioner, were approved vide respective orders as per the principles approved by the Commission vide order dated 8.12.2011 in Petition No. 68/2010. - (i) Aggrieved with the Commission’s order dated 1.9.2015 in Petition No. 240/TT/2013, the Petitioner filed Appeal No. 15 of 2016 before the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity (APTEL) on the issue of disallowance of time overrun for 3 months and 6 months related to Asset-2 and Asset-3 respectively. The APTEL, vide judgement dated 28.10.2022 in Appeal No. consequential orders. The relevant extracts of the APTEL said judgment dated 28.10.2022 are as follows: _10. The Central Commission is directed to pass consequential orders in light of the above decision”_ - (k) Pursuant to the APTEL’s judgment, the Commission in the remand order dated 17.8.2023 in Petition No 240/TT/2013, decided that adjustments in fees and charges for the concerned assets will be addressed when the Petitioner files a Petition for the truing up of fees and charges for the 201924 tariff period and for the determination of fees and charges for the 202429 tariff period. 7. The Respondents are the distribution companies and power departments, which are procuring transmission services (communication) from the Petitioner and are mainly beneficiaries of the Northern Region. 8. The Petitioner has served a copy of the Petition on the Respondents, and notice regarding the filing of this Petition has been published in the newspapers in accordance with Section 64 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (the Act). No comments or suggestions have been received from the general public in response to the aforesaid notices published in the newspapers by the Petitioner. None of the Respondents has filed any reply in the matter. 10. This order is being issued considering the Petitioner’s submissions in the Petition vide affidavits dated 6.1.2025 and 24.3.2025. 11. Having heard the Petitioner’s representative and perused the material available on record, we proceed to dispose of the Petition. 12. The fees and charges for the 2009-14 period for Asset-1, Asset-2, Asset-3 and Asset-4, earlier determined vide orders in Petition Nos. 240/TT/2013 and 22/TT/2014, were trued up vide order dated 9.7.2018 in Petition No 108/TT/2017 and IDC and IEDC were disallowed corresponding to the time overrun not condoned. Later, APTEL vide judgment dated 28.10.2022 in Appeal No.15 of 2016, the APTEL remanded back the Commission’s said order dated 1.9.2015 in Petition No. 240/TT/2013 for reconsideration. 27. IWC has been worked out in line with the methodology explained vide the orders in Petition No. 240/TT/2013 and 22/TT/2014. Asset-3, and Asset-4, as well as the trued-up tariff for Asset-5 claimed by the Petitioner, are as follows: 106. We have considered the Petitioner's submissions. The Petitioner is entitled to reimbursement of the fees paid for filing the Petition and the publication expenses incurred on this account, directly from the beneficiaries or long-term customers, as the case may be.
title: Revision of fees and charges from the COD to 31.3.2014 and for the 2014-19 tariff period for 2 Nos. assets under Fiber Optic Communication System in lieu of existing Unified Load Despatch and Communication (ULDC) Microwave Links in Northern Region as per remand order dated 17.08.2023 in Petition No. 240/TT/2013; - Petition for truing up of fees and charges for the 2019-24 tariff period and determination of fees and charges for the 2024-29 tariff block for 4 Nos. assets under Fiber Optic Communication System in lieu of existing Unified Load Despatch and Communication (ULDC) Microwave Links in Northern Region under Sub-section(4) of Section 28 of the Electricity Act, 2003 and under the Regulation 15 (1) (a) and Regulation 23 of Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023 read with Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 and Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2024.
